notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi,

We have received feedback and suggestions and made improvements to the game.

We've seen comments from people expressing their love for Long Dream and support for the WildMonkey Game Studio.

Long Dream may not be so long, but I hope it can leave a little touch in your heart.

Thank you very much!

notes.title: Long Dream is now available!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

WildMonkey's second pixel game [b] "Long Dream" [/b] is now available! We really appreciate your waiting and support! The game is priced at $6.99, with a 10% discount for the first week. We also offer you different bundles with extra discounts, maybe you could find the best option for you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2088030/

It has been half a year since the demo was released. We believe that Wang Han and Han Zhaosheng have brought you some joy and moved. Wang Han, who is 30 years old, single and unemployed. Can he find his life goal again? And Han Zhaosheng, whose illness is getting worse day by day. Can he find his beloved Qimei under the peach tree?

Welcome to this "Long Dream" and find the answer by yourself.

[b]WildMonkey & GameraGames[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918010/bb82ddcc99e19759ee143799785c79fe752837f6.png[/img]

[h3]2 bundles including Long Dream is out now![/h3]

To celebrate the release of Long Dream, we offer you two bundles with an additional 10% discount!

[b]Bundle 1: Long Dream + Bad Kids[/b]
This bundle includes two games developed by WildMonkey: Long Dream and Bad Kids.
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31057/

Includes 6 different styles of pixel games:  Long Dream, Bad Kids, The Rewinder, Distraint1&2 and Detective Di: The Silk Rose Murders.

notes.title: Long Dream Announced Today!
notes.notes:
Long Dream is my second game. 

The story will focus on Wang Han's grandpa Han Zhaosheng. He will cross time and space in his remaining life searching for the place where he and his partner made a promise to each other. Meanwhile, Wang Han is grown up and will witness the story of the older generation with us.

This time I work with publisher Gamera Games, and I will keep you updated with development progress. What' more, Long dream will show up in TGS·Gamera Games Now on September 15th——stay tuned!

[b]Long Dream is expected to launch in February 2023. [/b]

[b][h3]Wishlist my game if you are interested in pixel narrative game.[/h3][/b]

Thanks for your attention and support!
